slides.title: A 15-minute pre-market routine.
slides.text: Most bad trades are decided **before** the open.

points.t: Data releases, central bank speakers, earnings.
Flat before big releases, or smaller size.
The reference points most traders watch.
Where the market went while you slept.
"If price holds above X, I look for longs. If it loses Y, shorts."
Write them down. Everything else is a pass.
Hit it and you're done. No exceptions.
In dollars, decided now, not in the moment.

slides.title: Plan the trade before the market tempts you.
slides.text: Calendar, levels, plan, limits. Fifteen minutes that save the rest of the day.

post.instagram:
1. Calendar: news times today. 2. Levels: yesterday's high, low and close, overnight high and low. 3. Plan: two scenarios and the setups you'll take. 4. Limits: max daily loss, max number of trades, dollar risk per trade. Decided before the open, not in the moment.

Save this for later and follow @calmedgeofficial for one trading concept a day.

Educational content. Not financial advice; trading involves risk of loss.
